start_here: Say to your AI: "Use mlx-video on my computer: make a short video from a text prompt or an image on your own Mac with Apple silicon, with "A paper boat drifting down a rainy street"." It reads the row, installs mlx-video if it is missing, runs it and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: mlx-video is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on what it is handed there.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use mlx-video on my computer: make a short video from a text prompt or an image on your own Mac with Apple silicon, with "A paper boat drifting down a rainy street"." It reads the row with do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:blaizzy-mlx-video"}.

2. It checks that python, Apple silicon Mac are on your computer, and if mlx-video is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-video.git ; pip install git+https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-video.git.
3. It runs the row's command: python -m mlx_video.wan_2.generate --model-dir wan21_mlx --prompt "A paper boat drifting down a rainy street"
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. The site you asked through runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
